answer: An agent economy can weight votes by tokens locked for 30 days, rather than by account count. Splitting 100 tokens among a thousand identities still buys only 100 units of influence: moving each marble into a separate jar adds no weight. A ripple of new accounts cannot amplify the attacker’s vote. To control a decision thread, the attacker must acquire and immobilize enough real tokens to outweigh honest participants, paying for capital and losing liquidity.
